name: popsicle
headline: SmartRetail-Kit: AI Marketing & Sales Tools
short_description: AI & Automation tools to help small businesses grow through digital marketing, sales dashboards, and smart customer communication.
author: G-sahaab

sections.overview:
SmartRetail-Kit combines AI-powered marketing automation with practical tools built for small retail businesses. It includes an AI Marketing Generator for creating social media posts, a WhatsApp Marketing Toolkit for customer outreach, and sales dashboards that track daily conversions and KPIs. The toolkit uses OpenAI GPT, Google Sheets, Streamlit, and WhatsApp Business API to automate repetitive marketing tasks. Designed by a business professional with real-world retail experience, it helps local shop owners scale without technical expertise.
Generate social media posts automatically from product descriptions using AI
Send bulk WhatsApp offers and promotional messages to customer lists
Track daily sales, walk-ins, and conversion rates with visual dashboards
Create marketing content with Canva integration for quick visual posts
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/G-sahaab/SmartRetail-Kit`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a digital marketing assistant for a small retail business. Generate a 30-day social media content plan for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. Include 3 posts per week with captions, hashtags, and post types (image, video, carousel). Use [DATA] about their recent sales trends to tailor the content.
```
Copy

```
# 30-Day Social Media Content Plan for GreenLeaf Nursery

**Week 1: Spring Planting Kickoff**
- **Post 1 (Image):** "Spring is here! 🌷 Our top 5 plants for beginners. #GardeningTips #SpringPlants"
- **Post 2 (Video):** "Meet our team! 👋 See how we prepare your plants for shipping. #BehindTheScenes #PlantLovers"
- **Post 3 (Carousel):** "Before & After: See how our customers' gardens transformed! 🌿 #GardenInspo #PlantParents"

**Week 2: Customer Spotlights**
- **Post 4 (Image):** "Customer of the Week: Meet Sarah! 🌸 Her balcony garden is thriving! #CustomerLove #UrbanGardening"
- **Post 5 (Video):** "Unboxing our best-selling plant care kit! 📦 #PlantCare #Unboxing"
- **Post 6 (Carousel):** "Our top-selling plants this month! 🌱 #TrendingPlants #SpringSales"

*...and so on for the remaining weeks.*
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
